messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: P1 - inference-queue-high-latency (service: inference-queue). Trigger: queue_depth > 5k for 3m. PD incident: INC-9821. Auto-notify: #eng-oncall, priority: page.
Kai: acked on PD. I'm taking this. :hand:
Priya: thanks. can you share rough customer impact? any user-facing 5xx?
Jules: we're seeing a spike in pending requests on dispatcher queues. 95th latency degraded to ~4.2s and mean tokens/sec per replica dropped 40%. No 5xx at the gateway yet, but tail latencies spiking.
Marta: adding context — slow node provisioning earlier caused capacity holes, autoscaler didn't spawn fast enough due to recent kube quota change. logs: `autoscaler: scale_up_attempts=3, api_quota=429, backoff=60s`
Kai: ok. mitigation plan: 1) temporary manual scale to bridge load 2) lower batch window to reduce per-request queueing 3) open follow-up PD to infra for quota bump. doing manual scale now.
Kai: running: ```kubectl -n inference scale deployment dispatcher --replicas=30```
ops-runner: note: cluster quota is 28 for this pool, scale to 30 will get rejected unless we pick alternate nodepool. suggest: `kubectl annotate deployment dispatcher nodepool=burst-pool && kubectl scale deploy dispatcher --replicas=30`
Kai: switching to burst-pool and patching now. ```kubectl patch deploy/dispatcher -n inference -p '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"nodepool":"burst-pool"}}}}}' && kubectl scale deploy/dispatcher -n inference --replicas=30```
pagerduty-bot: PD INC-9821 updated: Kai acknowledged. Escalation policy: primary oncall -> infra escalation in 5m if not resolved.
Priya: while scale is in progress, can we reduce batch window? that should reduce added latency from long batch waits.
Jules: changing runtime config: `REDWOOD_BATCH_WINDOW_MS` from 50 -> 10 on the dispatcher pods. Applying via k8s rollout patch.
Marta: heads up: if we reduce batch window it may increase token cost. fine for mitigation, but note for billing alerts.
Kai: scale patched and replicas bumped to 30 on burst-pool, new pods coming up. watching rollout.
ops-runner: I see 10 new pods initializing; kube events: `FailedScheduling` earlier but now scheduled to burst-pool.
Jules: post-change logs show queue depth falling from 6.2k -> 1.8k in 90s. 95th latency trending down to 1.1s.
Priya: customer impact: routing spikes to standard plan show longer wait times for some requests; CS flagged a few reports but no major outage. Please capture affected tenant IDs for postmortem.
Kai: collecting request traces and tenant ids now (will dump to shared folder). Also opening incident runbook PR.
Marta: follow-ups: 1) revert batch window after capacity stabilizes 2) infra to review quota change that caused slower autoscaler 3) add autoscaler fallback to alternate nodepools automatically 4) add PD alert for sustained queue depth > 2k to catch earlier.
pagerduty-bot: PD INC-9821: resolved by user Kai. Resolution note: manual scale + batch window reduction reduced queue depth and tail latency. Escalation cancelled.
Kai: marking thread resolved. will post full postmortem draft in #postmortems within 24h. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Thread closed. Summary: manual scale to burst-pool + batch window reduction mitigated P1 queue surge. Investigations: kube quota change slowed autoscaler -> follow-ups assigned.
